## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Equities show headline strength with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%), while VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) ↓ falling signals lower fear but narrow participation keeps the call neutral.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) ↓ falling) versus mixed credit (HYG NEUTRAL (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) → flat and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) ↓ falling) — applause for equities but limited breadth.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tightening: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) ↓ falling (yields higher), Dollar and broad yield-curve signals neutral (ratios flat).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Concentrated leadership: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) and XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) showing strength, while Energy is a short-term bounce XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow sector advance.

**5. US vs Global?**
US headline strength with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +2.61%); EM/Asia improving — EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.17%) and FXI RECOVERY (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -2.76%) but China 1M weakness persists.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk intact: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.10%) and ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +8.41%) rising, yet ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +6.99%) and IWM CORRECTION (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) show short-term profit-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Mixed: agri and softs lead — WEAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) and DBA ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +5.67%); metals weak with GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.52%) and SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -8.57%) ↓ falling.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Patchy: oil futures bounce BNO RECOVERY (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) and XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) while nat gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) ↓ falling.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad-market leaders SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +2.61%). DIVERGENCE: multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches across XBI, ARKK, IWM, XLV (CORRECTIONs) — minor-to-moderate rotation that suppresses a decisive risk-on read.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) showing relative strength, reduce exposure to weak commodities and gas (UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%)) and monitor narrow breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%), XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%). BEARISH: XME BELOW TREND (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -10.63%), XLV CORRECTION (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +4.52%), XLU CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +3.91%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: WEAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%), DBA ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +5.67%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%), SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -8.57%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health watch), XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot), Breadth 4/11 (narrow advance warning).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive with headline indices ABOVE TREND but participation thin. XLK and XLF showing relative strength while multiple 1W/1M corrections (XBI, ARKK, IWM, XLV) are the key divergences to monitor.
